'''Arts and culture'''
*[[MeToo movement|#MeToo movement]]
**Actors [[Leonard Whiting]] and [[Olivia Hussey]], who starred in the [[Romeo and Juliet (1968 film)|1968 film adaptation]] of [[William Shakespeare]]'s ''[[Romeo and Juliet]]'', file a lawsuit in the [[Los Angeles County Superior Court]] against [[Paramount Pictures]] for [[United States dollar|US$]]500 million, alleging [[sexual abuse]], [[sexual harassment]], and fraud, and for being filmed in the nude without their knowledge. [https://apnews.com/article/entertainment-movies-franco-zeffirelli-lawsuits-legal-proceedings-f62cad4b78eec5d0486eef8a20ce35d5 (AFP)] [https://variety.com/2023/film/news/romeo-and-juliet-child-abuse-nude-scene-lawsuit-1235477837/ (''Variety'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Meta Platforms]] is fined [[Euro|€]]390 million by the [[European Union]], claiming that the company's collection of personal data from [[Facebook]] and [[Instagram]] accounts for [[targeted advertising|personalized ads]] was in violation of EU privacy laws. *The [[Competition Commission of India]] rejects an appeal from [[Google]] over its ruling in October that Google's dominant position in the [[search engine]] market and control of the [[Google Play|Android app store]] violated [[India]]'s antitrust laws.
